root_cause: Four Binance contracts contained post-settlement spans whose OHLC values were constant for the entire negative dependency interval. Seven/eight distinct context indices therefore rendered as identical normalized horizontal-line images, including one pixel hash shared across three symbols.
remediation: Reject a candidate unless its widest dependency interval contains at least four unique close values and four bars with high greater than low. Re-plan every negative event from the amended committed contract; do not edit images or silently drop rows after rendering.
